verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API (client listing, session history, aliases) and an open-source Python module with scripts. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, try-it console, or runnable in-browser examples, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. The Python scripts and CLI batch examples are developer building blocks and adjacent material, not an interactive API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
